Event Name: WHO Declares COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern
Description: World Health Organization declares the COVID-19 outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

Event Name: WHO Declares COVID-19 a Global Pandemic
Description: World Health Organization officially characterizes the COVID-19 outbreak as a global pandemic
column9: triggering worldwide lockdowns and travel restrictions.

Description: The container ship Ever Given runs aground and blocks the Suez Canal for six days
column9: delaying an estimated hundreds of vessels and global trade shipments.

Event Name: Russia Launches Full-Scale Invasion of Ukraine
Description: Russia launches a full-scale military invasion of Ukraine
column9: triggering a major European security crisis and global energy and commodity market shocks.

Event Name: US Federal Reserve Begins 2022 Rate-Hike Cycle
Description: The US Federal Reserve raises its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points
column10: beginning an aggressive tightening cycle to combat inflation.

Event Name: European Central Bank's First Rate Hike in 11 Years
Description: The ECB raises its key interest rates by 0.50 percentage points
column10: marking the start of a euro-area tightening cycle amid surging inflation.

Description: Underwater explosions rupture the Nord Stream 1 and Nord Stream 2 gas pipelines in the Baltic Sea
column9: deepening Europe's natural gas supply crisis.

Event Name: OPEC+ Announces Major Oil Production Cut
Description: OPEC+ agrees to cut oil production by 2 million barrels per day
column9: one of its largest cuts since 2020

Event Name: 2023 Banking Crisis (SVB Collapse and Credit Suisse Takeover)
Description: Silicon Valley Bank collapses on March 10 and Credit Suisse is forced into a UBS-led takeover on March 19
column9: triggering fears of a wider global banking contagion.

Event Name: WHO Ends COVID-19 Global Health Emergency
Description: The World Health Organization declares that COVID-19 no longer constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern
column9: formally ending the pandemic emergency phase.
